title: bmo command dispatch
what: The thin entry point bmo: finds the bmo-<name> unit commands beside it and on PATH, reads and caches the nouns they declare, resolves a command by the longest declared noun or the git rule, and hands it on or answers it.

title: Home bridge client
what: A command whose declared noun carries the home mark, asked on a work node, is handed whole to the operations machine over the socket BMO_HOME_BRIDGE names, and its relayed output and exit code are the run.
